messages:
Maria: Starting canary for cobalt-23b-quant-v1 on the canary GPU pool. Default batching=4, max_new_tokens=512. Hitting OOMs on ~8k token sessions, looks like mem fragmentation
Alex: Can you paste the run config + the error log?
Maria: snippet from the canary node:
```
INF 2026-03-21 12:01:23 serve: alloc failed: best-fit couldn't satisfy 288MB
KV Cache: 1.2GB used, slot fragments high (free slots scattered)
Active batches: [4,4,4] (no adaptive pacing)
```
Jing: Hmm, int4 allocator + large max_new_tokens + heavy prefix priming is a known fragmentation amplifier. Two quick levers: lower max_new_tokens, or enable dynamic-slot-reserve/compaction.
Sam: We could also try adaptive batch pacing so big long-context reqs don't co-reside. Maybe prefer_short_requests=true and max_batch_size=4.
Maria: Quick experiment: deployed overrides -> max_new_tokens=256, batching=2, kv_trim_threshold=0.6, prefetch=false (disabled aggressive prefetch).
infra-bot: Deploy 1715167890-cobalt23b-quant-v1 -> canary rollout completed in 34s :white_check_mark:
Maria: Early results: no OOMs for first 1k long requests, p50 latency +5ms, p95 +40ms on some tails, token cost ~same. Memory fragmentation metrics look improved.
Alex: Solid. For safe rollout plan: 1) 24h canary with current overrides, 2) full perf benchmark comparing throughput/cost vs baseline, 3) add long-prompt eval (12k tokens) to regression harness.
Jing: I'll file an allocator issue: add compaction trigger when free-frag >30% and consider a background slot-shuffle in low-traffic windows.
Sam: For immediate safety net, add a runtime fallback to the fp16 variant when memory_pressure > 0.85 so we avoid hard OOMs while investig.
Maria: Will open the PR with rollout config + initial metrics. Action items: Maria -> PR + start 24h canary; Jing -> allocator compaction issue + design note; Alex -> run benchmark script against canary; Sam -> add fallback policy to runtime config. Ping me if anything trips.
Alex: ack
Jing: ack
Sam: ack
infra-bot: Canary metrics update (1h): memory p95 down 18%, fragmentation index down 0.32 -> 0.19, OOMs: 0 in last hour :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maria: Thanks all — closing this thread. Will post PR link and bench results once done.
